description: This file defines the class RepairCommands, a set of Robo tasks for maintaining and repairing aspects of the SuiteCRM system, including database repair, extension rebuilds, relationship rebuilds, and record normalization.

classes.name: RepairCommands
classes.description: A Robo task class providing various maintenance commands for SuiteCRM, such as database repair, extension rebuilding, relationship regeneration, and record normalization.

methods.name: repairDatabase
methods.description: Synchronizes database tables with vardefs, optionally executing SQL queries to repair tables.

methods.name: repairRebuildExtensions
methods.description: Rebuilds CRM extension files in the custom/Extension directory.

methods.name: repairRebuildRelationships
methods.description: Rebuilds module relationships defined in module vardefs.

methods.name: repairNormalizeRecordEncoding
methods.description: Performs record normalization, either synchronously or asynchronously, with options for repair range and tracking.
